# Code of conduct

## Our pledge

We want MineSim to be a friendly place to learn, build and ask questions. We
welcome contributions from people of every background and experience level.

## Expected behavior

- Be kind and specific. Critique the code, the design or the documentation,
  not the person.
- Assume good faith and ask before assuming someone is acting in bad faith.
- Keep discussion on topic and move long side conversations to a separate
  thread.
- Respect privacy. Do not publish private messages, personal data or security
  tokens.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, insults, threats, discriminatory language, sexualized attention,
doxxing and sustained disruption are not welcome. Spam, scams and attempts to
get other people to run untrusted scripts are also not welcome.

## Scope

This code of conduct applies in the repository, issue tracker, discussions,
pull requests, chat spaces and any other project space.

## Reporting and enforcement

If you see a problem, contact the maintainers through the repository profile.
Reports are handled privately. Maintainers may remove content, ask for a pause,
or temporarily or permanently ban a participant, depending on the situation.
Retaliation against someone who reports a problem is not acceptable.

## Attribution

This document is inspired by the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1, and adapted
to this project.
